description: This Java class defines an abstract validator for patterns, verifying that a given CharSequence (such as a String) matches a specified regular expression pattern within certain constraints like maximum length. It is part of a validation framework for entity attributes in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractPatternValidator
classes.description: An abstract class implementing a pattern validation mechanism for CharSequence identifiers, enforcing maximum length and pattern matching rules.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the input CharSequence against length and pattern constraints, storing failure reasons if validation fails.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the reason for validation failure, if any.
